title: A bulk change where every part fails keeps the selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in tab 1 on the Inventory page, on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click the part B row.
  6. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address.
  7. In tab 2, click Parts in the top bar.
  8. In tab 2, click Inventory in the left menu.
  9. In tab 2, type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  10. In tab 2, click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  11. In tab 2, click Deactivate parts.
  12. In tab 2, click the part A row.
  13. In tab 2, click the part B row.
  14. In tab 2, click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  15. In tab 2, click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  16. Switch back to tab 1 without reloading it.
  17. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  18. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  19. Wait 10 seconds without closing the message.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 4:

  • The part A row is ticked.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 2 selected.

Step 6:

  • A second tab opens.

Step 7:

  • Tab 2 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 8:

  • Tab 2 shows the Inventory page.

Step 9:

  • Parts A and B are listed in tab 2.

Step 10:

  • The menu opens in tab 2.

Step 11:

  • Bulk mode turns on in tab 2.

Step 12:

  • The part A row is ticked in tab 2.

Step 13:

  • Tab 2's bar reads 2 selected.

Step 14:

  • The confirmation opens in tab 2.

Step 15:

  • Tab 2 shows "2 parts updated.": parts A and B are now inactive.

Step 16:

  • Tab 1 still shows parts A and B ticked.

Step 17:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 18:

  • A red message reads "No parts were changed." and lists parts A and B, each with "Part is already in that state."
  • The list stays on screen, bulk mode stays on and both parts are still ticked (the bar reads 2 selected), ready to retry.

Step 19:

  • The red message is still on screen after 10 seconds: it stays until closed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-N2: “If every part in a bulk change fails, the list stays on screen and the selection is kept, so the user can retry.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Bulk change, every part failed | "No parts were changed." | Error toast, stays until closed, lists each failed part and its reason”
  • User Feedback Summary: “A part already in the requested state | "Part is already in that state." | Listed as the failure reason”
